Purpose: exact Landometer motifs, ijji animated identity, and ijji pending-state motifs for dev, designer, product, sales, and authorized AI/agent workflows.

Agent rules:
1. Read agentContract in assets/motif-library.json and choose one exact baseline record.
2. Keep `landometer.motif.v3`, `ijji.logo-sting.r3`, and `ijji.four-beat.selected-3.r3` separate.
3. Landometer communication remains product-neutral across Land, Location, and Living.
4. ijji assets remain product-specific; do not generalize F&B, retail, municipality, CityWiki, or city-specific examples into portfolio truth.
5. Do not redraw, recolor, crop, distort, trace screenshots, or reconstruct from memory.
6. Landometer production motion is finite once. Logo full/quiet end at 2870/3360 ms; never use the old 2050 ms cutoff with v3.
7. ijji animated identity uses only the exact superset runtime and layer PNGs; full is 9s, mark-only is 6.4s. Production plays once and holds final.
8. ijji selected motifs are pending-state only and stop on success, failure, cancel, or timeout.
9. This library webpage auto-replays the hero, both full brand logos, six INTENT → AHA → NEXT ACTION motifs, and Preview; portable snippets keep their declared finite-once or state-bound lifecycle.
10. Verify the final rendered/exported output and report every unverified gate.
11. For Drive retrieval, resolve release-index.json and verify the immutable release manifest/checksum.

Rights: public availability is not an unrestricted third-party or open-source license. Follow LICENSE.md and governance/owner-approval.json.
